title: Croatian Field Boundaries
description:
Field boundary data for Croatia, provided as part of national agricultural datasets.

This dataset contains spatial data related to agricultural land use in Croatia, including ARKOD parcel information,
environmentally sensitive areas, High Nature Value Grasslands, protective buffer strips around watercourses, and vineyard
classifications. The data is crucial for managing agricultural activities, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations,
and supporting sustainable land use practices.

This collection holds 1 edition (2024), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/hr/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2024). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:3765). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/hr/AGENTS.md).

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Croatia — latest edition (2024) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2024/hr-2024.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-hcat-crops.title: Crops (HCAT)
style-hcat-crops.description: Fields coloured by harmonized crop (EuroCrops HCAT code, `hcat:code`). The 11 crops covering the most area are named, everything else is grey. Colours follow the fiboa.org crop map palette.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
